About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers. Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Target as a tech company? Absolutely. We're the behind-the-scenes powerhouse that fuels Target's passion and commitment to cutting-edge innovation. We anchor every facet of one of the world's best-loved retailers with a strong technology framework that relies on the latest tools and technologies, and the brightest people, to deliver incredible value to guests online and in stores.

Target Technology Services is on a mission to offer the systems, tools and support that guests and team members need and deserve. Our high-performing teams balance independence with collaboration, and we pride ourselves on being versatile, agile and creative. We drive industry-leading technologies in support of every angle of the business and help ensure that Target operates smoothly, securely and reliably from the inside out.

As a Director of Technology, Enterprise Modernization,
you will be responsible for leading Target's enterprise modernization strategy and execution efforts. This team plays a critical role in accelerating Target's long-term technology transformation by creating enterprise-wide clarity, coordinating execution across multiple portfolios, and enabling engineering organizations to modernize legacy platforms and systems at scale.

Unlike traditional engineering leadership roles, success in this position is achieved through influence, collaboration, and execution across distributed teams rather than direct ownership of all engineering delivery. You will lead a team of Technical Program Managers and engineers responsible for defining modernization strategies, driving enterprise-wide alignment, identifying cross-portfolio dependencies, and solving common challenges that enable engineering teams to move faster.

Use your skills, experience, and talents to be a part of groundbreaking thinking and visionary goals.

As a Director of Technology
, you'll lead the Enterprise Modernization
organization by understanding, advocating, and communicating company objectives, vision, and strategy to senior leaders and stakeholders across Technology. You will turn complex and ambiguous challenges into clear strategies, actionable roadmaps, and measurable outcomes that drive enterprise impact.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, Architecture, Product, and Business teams to identify modernization opportunities, establish priorities, and coordinate execution across multiple portfolios. You will develop and foster key stakeholder relationships and provide clear, consistent communication on progress, risks, decisions, dependencies, and areas requiring leadership support.

In this role, you will act as a change agent, helping teams navigate large-scale transformation while creating alignment across organizations that may not report directly to you. You will bring a strong bias for action and sustained follow-through, driving decisions to closure, holding owners accountable, and ensuring complex cross-portfolio work continues to move forward. You will continuously determine what is best owned within portfolios versus solved centrally, and establish the common solutions, standards and capabilities that can accelerate progress across the enterprise.

You will leverage your technical expertise to understand complex architectures, connect dependencies, challenge assumptions, and ask the right questions to remove obstacles and drive execution. Strong technical judgment and credibility are essential to shape technical direction and engage effectively with senior engineers, architects, and technology leaders.

Additionally, you will lead and develop a high-performing team of technical program managers and engineers, establishing clear expectations, accountability, and measurable outcomes. You will create an environment that encourages collaboration, problem-solving, innovation, and continuous improvement while helping team members grow their skills and careers.

The impact of this role is substantial. Mainframe modernization and broader enterprise transformation efforts are ultimately delivered by engineering organizations across Merchandising, Supply Chain, Stores, Finance, and other portfolios. This team serves as a force multiplier by creating clarity, solving the right problems centrally, and helping those organizations execute more efficiently and effectively.

Experience leading large-scale technology transformation or modernization initiatives within complex enterprise environments
Strong business acumen and ability to connect technology strategy to business outcomes

Preferred Experience

Description

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Head of Engineering to lead a critical product domain within our supply chain platform for perishable goods. In this environment, timing, traceability, reliability, and operational excellence are core product requirements.

Reporting directly to the CTO, you will own your domain end-to-end, including technical strategy, architecture, engineering execution, team development, quality, and business outcomes. You will lead a lean, high-performing engineering organization that delivers through an agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), where AI-assisted workflows help accelerate specification, development, testing, and review while maintaining human accountability at every stage.

This role is designed for a technical leader who can think strategically, make sound architectural decisions, develop engineering talent, and engage deeply in technical discussions when needed. While you will not be the primary implementer, you will be expected to provide technical direction, evaluate complex tradeoffs, and guide your teams through critical decisions.

What You'll Do
Technical Leadership & Ownership

Own the technical direction, architecture, delivery, quality, and operational performance of a product domain.
Make and guide architectural decisions that balance scalability, reliability, maintainability, and business needs.
Evaluate technical proposals from engineering leads and teams, challenging assumptions and identifying risks when necessary.
Provide technical guidance during critical design reviews, production incidents, and high-impact initiatives.
Establish engineering standards, development practices, and quality expectations across your domain.

Engineering Management

Lead and develop a lean, senior engineering organization consisting of:
Engineering leads
Senior full-stack engineers
Early-career engineers and new graduates
Offshore specialist teams

Coach managers and senior contributors, helping them grow their technical and leadership capabilities.
Build a strong succession pipeline and continuously strengthen team capabilities.

Agentic Software Delivery

Drive delivery through an AI-enabled engineering workflow where agents assist with specification generation, coding, testing, code review, and quality assurance.
Ensure appropriate human oversight and accountability throughout the development lifecycle.
Improve team effectiveness by helping engineers leverage AI tooling and automation in a disciplined, high-quality manner.
Continuously optimize engineering processes to improve throughput, quality, and speed of delivery.

Quality, Reliability & Operations

Maintain a high standard for system reliability and operational excellence.
Ensure systems support real-world supply chain requirements, including inventory accuracy, shipment timing, traceability, and compliance.
Proactively identify technical debt, operational risks, and scalability challenges before they impact customers.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with Product, TPM, Security, Operations, and peer engineering leaders to align roadmaps and execution priorities.
Influence platform investments and shared engineering initiatives across the organization.
Communicate technical strategy, progress, and risk clearly to executive stakeholders and board-level audiences.

What Success Looks Like

In This Role, Success Includes

Consistent delivery of high-quality software through the agentic development pipeline.
Faster idea-to-production cycles while maintaining engineering standards.
Increased engineering leverage and measurable improvements in team productivity.
Strong collaboration between onshore and offshore teams.
Successful onboarding and development of agent-native early-career engineers.
Reliable systems that meet demanding operational and traceability requirements.
A growing bench of engineering leaders capable of taking on larger responsibilities.

Minimum Qualifications

12+ years of software engineering experience.
6+ years of engineering leadership experience managing senior engineers and technical teams.
Proven experience owning delivery and outcomes for a production software product or platform domain.
Strong system design and architecture expertise with the ability to review and evaluate technical implementations.
Experience leading distributed engineering organizations across onshore and offshore teams.
Demonstrated ability to balance engineering quality, business priorities, and delivery timelines.
Experience communicating technical decisions, risks, and strategy to executive stakeholders.
Experience working in high-accountability environments where teams are responsible for outcomes end-to-end.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted development, agentic engineering workflows, LLM-powered tooling, or related software delivery approaches.
Experience improving engineering productivity through automation, AI, or modern developer platforms.
Background in supply chain, logistics, inventory management, warehouse systems, food safety, traceability, IoT, sensor-based systems, or similarly complex operational domains.
Experience leading small, highly leveraged engineering teams that consistently deliver outsized results.
Experience presenting technical roadmaps, investment priorities, and risk assessments to board-level audiences.

Responsible for performing professional process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of the company’s complex semiconductor capital equipment and systems.
Reviews processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture, fabrication and evaluation of products. Involvement may begin at any step from pilot plant to full-scale manufacturing.

Compiles and evaluates test data to determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications.
Supports customer technology managers in the planning, data collection, analysis, and reporting of customer demos to defend existing process applications.
Works with customer and senior engineers cross functionally to understand roadmaps, process flow, inflection points, requirements and business issues/ challenges.
Utilize simulation tools like Sem3D (MAPD) & AI/ML based tools to drive process development strategies in optimizing the etch processes.
Analyze data and provide insights to improve process performance, yield and efficiency. Utilize JMP and other tools to generate process sensitivities and trade-offs
Work closely with C&F (concept & feasibility) teams to drive and adopt new process innovations and technology roadmaps. Great presentation skills to clearly articulate demo status, complex etch strategies

Works with customer to demonstrate and introduce new technologies at customer sites through demos, on site evaluations, and new tool qualifications.

Minimum Qualifications

Who we’re looking for

Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 12+ years of experience; or a PhD with 10+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.
Leadership responsibilities
Lead a team of Junior & Senior process engineers to enable successful penetration & defense of key etch applications directly impacting Lam revenue
Responsible for managing multiple customer accounts in driving Lam Etch Tool Strategy, enabling successful tool evaluations at the customer site & driving new business opportunities.
Acts as a hands-on technical manager & leader for colleagues with less experience, coach them, and ensure successful engagement of the team in driving Lam Etch objectives.
Responsible for creating & presenting technical review material for key technical projects on frequent basis for high level TRMs at customer site.
Will be subject matter expert & key technologist with etch experience in process development in advanced technology nodes, will be responsible in coming up with solutions & implementing learnings from global scientific community in new approaches for some of grand etch challenges.
Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results as needed to enable successful tool demo and business wins/defenses.

Customer Relation

Professionally represent the company to the customer. Utilize knowledge of company’s product lines and services to keep existing/ potential customers informed when new/ additional needs are identified.

Other Job Responsibilities

Comfortable with travelling 10-20% of the time after training for on-site customer support.

Preferred Qualifications

In depth understanding of Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP).
Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.
Experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.
Interest in advanced technology and an on-going desire to learn.
In-depth understanding and working knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE); experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and ability to react to shifting priorities to meet business needs and deadlines.
Excellent people skills with demonstrated ability to work effectively and efficiently with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, internal and external partners.
Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment
Handling development projects and supporting semiconductor customers

The Assessment & Technology Solutions team supports the Kite® platform and Dynamic Learning Maps® (DLM®) assessments, which annually serve hundreds of thousands of students across multiple states. Summary of Job Duties:

The Director of Advancement Information Technology leads the technology strategy and operations that support University Advancement at the University of Arkansas. Dedicated full-time to Advancement, the Director owns the Advancement application portfolio, donor and constituent data, system integrations, reporting and analytics, and vendor relationships in service of the university’s fundraising, alumni engagement, and donor relations goals.

The Director reports to the Chief Information Officer (or designee) within University IT Services, with a dotted-line relationship to the Vice Chancellor for Advancement (or designee). This structure ensures the role operates within enterprise IT standards for security, identity, architecture, and data while remaining fully accountable to Advancement’s mission and priorities.

The Director will work as a senior individual contributor, leveraging AI agents, automation, and integration tooling alongside UITS shared service teams — including Applications Development, Integrations, Microsoft Fabric and the Enterprise Data Platform, Identity and Security, and Project Management — to deliver Advancement priorities.

Regular, reliable, and non-disruptive attendance is an essential job duty, as is the ability to create and maintain collegial, harmonious working relationships with others.

Demonstrated experience managing vendor relationships, contracts, and service performance

Hands-on experience with the Salesforce platform (Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Nonprofit Cloud) or a comparable enterprise CRM ecosystem
Experience with Advancement-specific systems such as Affinaquest, Advancement RM, Blackbaud, Encoura’s Anthology Encompass, VanillaSoft, Give Campus, ThankView, EverTrue, or similar
Experience with integration tooling (SnapLogic, Gearset, MuleSoft, Boomi, Informatica, or similar) and modern reporting and analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI)
Experience applying AI agents, automation, or low-code tooling to scale the capacity of small IT teams

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

Working knowledge of fundraising data structures, donor pipelines, gift processing workflows, and prospect management practices
Familiarity with email deliverability practices (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and large-volume constituent communications

Job Description

We have an opportunity to impact your career and provide an adventure where you can push the limits of what's possible.

As a Lead Software Engineer at JPMorganChase within the Asset & Wealth Management, Alternatives Team, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. Drive significant business impact through your capabilities and contributions, and apply deep technical expertise and problem-solving methodologies to tackle a diverse array of challenges that span multiple technologies and applications.

You will be a hands-on Java/Spring Boot Developer building and modernizing platforms that support alternative investments and the teams that service them. You will help re-platform critical applications from on‑premises to AWS, delivering cloud-native services with strong engineering discipline across system design, development, testing, and operational stability. You will shape distributed integration patterns, including messaging and event streaming, to improve resiliency, scalability, and observability. You will also lead effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development tools, setting team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.

Job Responsibilities

Regularly provides technical guidance and direction to support the business and its technical teams, contractors, and vendors
Develops secure and high-quality production code, and reviews and debugs code written by others
Drives adoption and governance of approved AI-assisted engineering practices across teams to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test acceleration, release readiness, incident/root-cause analysis), while establishing measurable validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of proven patterns and automation within the SDLC/TLM toolchain.
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including approved AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation at scale.
Drives decisions that influence the product design, application functionality, and technical operations and processes
Serves as a function-wide subject matter expert in one or more areas of focus
Actively contributes to the engineering community as an advocate of firmwide frameworks, tools, and practices of the Software Development Life Cycle

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 5+ years applied experience
Proven hands-on experience delivering system design, application development, testing, and operational stability in production environments
Advanced proficiency in Java (enterprise backend development), with strong practical experience building services using Spring Boot (or equivalent Java frameworks)
Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating integrations using messaging and/or event streaming services (e.g., Kafka, AWS MSK, SQS/SNS, Kinesis), including reliable delivery patterns, error handling, and observability in production
Practical, hands-on cloud-native experience (the team's target platform is AWS), including building/deploying/operating services in a cloud environment
Demonstrated experience leading effective use of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security
Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching senior engineers/leads on compliant usage patterns and controls.
Ability to tackle design and functionality problems independently with little to no oversight

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills

Reactive programming experience (e.g., Reactor) and event-driven / messaging & streaming familiarity
Financial services / wealth or alternatives domain experience

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

added.title: Senior Director Information Technology
added.description:
The Senior Director, Information Technology will lead the strategy, operations, security, and evolution of the company’s enterprise technology environment. Reporting to the SVP, Technology & Business Operations, this leader will oversee the internal IT team while managing Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and strategic technology partners.

This role requires someone who can balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution. As the company advances its clinical programs and scales its operations, the Senior Director will ensure the technology environment remains secure, compliant, reliable, and scalable.

The position will partner closely with Clinical Development, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, HR, Research, Informatics, and other functions to strengthen cybersecurity, modernize technology operations, improve the employee technology experience, and expand the responsible use of AI and automation.

This position is based in South San Francisco and requires onsite presence a minimum of three days per week.

Key Responsibilities

IT Strategy & Operations
Develop and execute the enterprise IT strategy and roadmap aligned with business growth, clinical development, security, and compliance requirements.
Lead enterprise IT services, including Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoint management, networking, cloud services, business applications, and end-user support.
Improve the employee technology experience, including onboarding, access provisioning, authentication, and technical support.
Establish service levels, operational metrics, and performance standards to drive accountability and continuous improvement.
Lead IT financial planning, budgeting, and technology investment prioritization.

IT Leadership & Managed Services
Lead and develop the internal IT organization across IT Operations, Infrastructure, and Helpdesk.
Manage and evolve an MSP-enabled operating model for end-user support and infrastructure.
Establish clear responsibilities and service expectations between internal IT teams, MSPs, and strategic technology partners.
Manage vendor performance, service quality, escalations, costs, and continuous improvement.
Maintain internal ownership of technology strategy, cybersecurity, risk, and business outcomes.
Stay close enough to day-to-day technology operations to identify issues, remove roadblocks, and provide hands-on guidance when needed.

Cybersecurity, Risk & Compliance
Develop and execute a multi-year cybersecurity strategy covering identity, endpoints, networks, SaaS applications, data protection, monitoring, third-party risk, and incident response.
Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity risks.
Maintain strong disaster recovery, business continuity, and incident response capabilities.
Support SOX, GDPR, audits, access controls, GxP, GAMP 5, and computer system validation requirements.

Business & Clinical Partnership
Partner with Clinical Development, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, HR, Research, Drug Discovery, Informatics, and Technical Operations.
Anticipate business needs and translate them into scalable technology solutions and roadmap priorities.
Support technology requirements for global clinical development, CROs, and other external partners.
Partner with business owners on the selection and implementation of critical enterprise platforms, including clinical, quality, and document management systems.

AI & Automation
Help lead the secure and responsible adoption of enterprise AI technologies.
Partner with Informatics, Data Science, Legal, and business teams on AI governance, architecture, security, and adoption.
Evaluate enterprise AI platforms and opportunities to securely integrate approved AI tools with internal company information and systems.
Identify opportunities to automate routine processes and improve productivity across the organization.

Qualifications

15+ years of progressive IT experience, including 5+ years in technology leadership.
Experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or another highly regulated industry.
Clinical-stage biotech/pharma and public-company experience strongly preferred.
Demonstrated success leading enterprise IT within a cloud-first, SaaS-based environment.
Experience managing MSPs and strategic technology partners.
Strong background in cybersecurity, business continuity, disaster recovery, and risk management.
Knowledge of SOX, GDPR, GxP, GAMP 5, and computer system validation.
Experience with enterprise applications, Microsoft 365, identity and access management, endpoint management, networking, cloud infrastructure, and end-user services.
Experience using automation and emerging technologies, including AI, to improve business operations.
Strong business judgment and ability to communicate and partner effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational change while remaining hands-on when necessary.

Ideal Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate is a strategic but hands-on technology leader who can build a high-performing IT organization, effectively manage external partners, strengthen cybersecurity and compliance, and support the technology needs of a growing clinical-stage life sciences company. This person should be equally comfortable developing a long-term technology roadmap, advising senior leadership, and stepping into operational issues when necessary.

updated.description:
The Senior Director, Technology Business Partner leads the strategic alignment of technology initiatives with business objectives, ensuring seamless integration and effective delivery of IT services. This role involves close collaboration with business units, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, InfoSec, and Operations to meet both business and security requirements. The Senior Director also works with customers and managed service vendors to ensure technology solutions are aligned with business needs and operational excellence.

This specific role is focused on leading technology strategy and delivery for our Medicare Advantage (MA) business, ensuring solutions are scalable, compliant, and aligned to critical MA capabilities. The ideal candidate brings strong MA technology experience, understands the regulatory and operational complexity of the MA ecosystem, and can translate business needs into actionable roadmaps and delivery plans. Additionally, this leader will also bring an AI-first mindset, identifying opportunities to use AI-enabled tools, automation, and modern delivery practices to improve productivity, quality, and speed while ensuring responsible use of AI in a regulated healthcare environment.

Oversee IT projects to ensure they meet business requirements, manage resources, budgets, and risks, and ensure timely project delivery.
Act as the main link between IT and business units to understand their needs and create IT strategies that support business goals.
Manage daily operations of key technology capabilities, maintain system reliability and performance, and optimize resource allocation.
Lead and mentor the IT team, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment, and manage recruitment and performance.
Build and maintain strong relationships with business stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and collaboration.

5+ years of senior management experience with demonstrated knowledge of strategic planning and experience developing and implementing strategies for achieving business objectives and organizing and managing multiple priorities
5+ years of direct experience delivering Medicare Advantage technology programs, including end-to-end ecosystem build-out spanning enrollment, bid/pricing, encounter data submission, risk adjustment, Stars quality, utilization management, and care/behavioral health management.
Experience managing system integrator and BPO/managed service vendor relationships specific to MA implementations (e.g., claims processing, care management platforms, member engagement tools).
Demonstrated experience leading technology delivery teams in applying an AI-first approach, including evaluating and adopting AI-enabled tools and practices to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and drive measurable productivity gains across the program.

Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Proven track record of successfully aligning IT initiatives with business strategies.
Ability to build strong relationships and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Experience with budget management and resource allocation.
Exceptional portfolio and project management skills for the effective deployment of resources and achievement of multiple projects in a cross-functional environment.
Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to negotiate, persuade, and make effective presentations to varying audiences internal and external to the organization.
Proven experience with effective vendor management.
Proven ability to successfully lead a team in all phases of developing products for the healthcare software application and services marketplace, including product management, product development, marketing, sales, and implementation.
Proven ability to translate CMS regulatory and Stars/quality requirements into actionable technology roadmaps and delivery plans.
